value.rationale: This is a complete and natural minimal-two-heat-mode asynchronous sensor design classification for unknown initial modal coefficients, not a merely renamed known bound. It quantifies how differing heat decay exponents drive distinct spatial relocation scales, and shows an exact 27/16 information-determinant advantage over fixed equal-time geometry at long horizons. Its scope excludes uncertain movement constraints, additional modes, and numerical-performance claims; those limitations do not remove the motivation for a sharp finite two-observation benchmark.
